newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia, Argentina trade exchanges rise sharply.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia, Argentina trade exchanges rise sharply.

text.p: Trade exchanges between Tunisia and Argentina rose to $108 million in 1996 from $28 million in 1995, the Argentinian Senate Speaker said on Thursday.

Eduardo Menem told journalists at the end of a three-day visit to Tunisia during which he met with Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali that there were new opportunities for cooperation between the two countries in the energy, tourism and shipping sectors."
He added that Tunisian President Ben Ali would visit soon Argentina at the invitation of President Carlos Menem.
